programme.title: U-455 Il Sottomarino Dimenticato
programme.desc: Nell’estate 2008, un sottomarino tedesco intatto viene scoperto al largo delle coste italiane a 120 metri. Seguendo l’archeologo Lorenzo del Veneziano, si svela la storia dell’U-455, protagonista delle battaglie navali dal Baltico al Mediterraneo.

programme.title: Il naufragio del Baron Gautsch
programme.desc: Il 13 agosto 1914 il Baron Gautsch solca le acque del mare Adriatico diretto a Trieste. È in ritardo e il capitano decide di tenersi più vicino alla costa così la rotta sarà più breve. È la decisione fatale...!

programme.title: The Perón Identity
programme.desc: Juan Domingo Perón, tre volte presidente argentino, nascose per tutta la vita le sue vere origini. Un'indagine storica svela il segreto che avrebbe potuto distruggerne l’ascesa politica.

programme.title: Trump: potere, politica, accuse
programme.desc: Un viaggio attraverso la vita politica di Donald Trump, come è salito al potere, è caduto in disgrazia e ha subito le conseguenze delle sue azioni criminali.

programme.title: La notte del conte rosso
programme.desc: 24 maggio 1941, il piroscafo Conte Rosso fu affondato da un sottomarino britannico al largo di Siracusa. Quella notte morirono in mare 1297 soldati. Fu uno dei più grandi disastri nella storia della Marina Militare Italiana.

programme.title: Mysteries of Paris
programme.desc: Sono tante le leggende e i miti che circolano nell’universo parigino nel corso della sua storia. Ma non tutto ha una spiegazione. Molti misteri restano tali.

programme.title: Mysteries of Paris
programme.desc: Per secoli la figura di Flamel, uno dei più famosi alchimisti del Medioevo, è stata oggetto di leggende. Molti ritengono che egli abbia scoperto il segreto della produzione dell'oro e dell'elisir di lunga vita.

programme.title: Mysteries of Paris
programme.desc: Questa puntata prende in esame uno degli episodi più oscuri della storia di Parigi, il cosiddetto affare dei veleni, un periodo storico inquietante caratterizzato da morte, torture e messe nere, dove nessuno era al sicuro, nemmeno Luigi XIV.

programme.title: Versailles: ascesa e caduta Il sogno del Re Sole
programme.desc: Versailles, simbolo della gloria francese, fu teatro di tre regni reali dal 1643 al 1792. Questa serie in 3 episodi ricostruisce la vita, gli amori e il potere di Luigi XIV, XV e XVI, tra splendori e la caduta della monarchia Bourbon.

programme.title: Piramidi I Misteri Svelati
programme.sub-title: Cheope E La Tomba Dei Segreti
programme.desc: La piramide di Cheope, unica meraviglia antica ancora in piedi alta 146 m, affascina da 4500 anni. La fotogrammetria mostra la sua costruzione precisa senza tecnologia moderna.

programme.title: Piramidi I Misteri Svelati
programme.desc: Gli archeologi esplorano la piramide di Djoser a Saqqara, scoprendo un reticolato di gallerie sotterranee. Con Imhotep, architetto del faraone, e grazie alla fotogrammetria, trovano nuovi indizi sui metodi di costruzione antichi.

programme.title: Piramidi I Misteri Svelati
programme.sub-title: Meidum E Il Mistero Della Falsa Piramide
programme.desc: Nella valle del Nilo, a 80 km dal Cairo, si trova la piramide di Meidum, detta “falsa piramide”. Attribuita al faraone Snefru, è priva di firma. Grazie a fotogrammetria e studi, gli egittologi ricostruiscono la sua storia di 4500 anni fa.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Oggy Petit Poucet
programme.desc: Oggy rentre chez lui avec son caddie plein de nourriture. Mais trouver sa maison devient une tâche impossible car toutes les rues se ressemblent ! Il décide alors de laisser une traînée de courses derrière lui, comme le petit Tom Pouce.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Géant!
programme.desc: Marky se met soudain à grandir de façon incontrôlée. Bientôt, il est encore plus grand que la maison et n'arrive pas à manger suffisamment. Il va piller la ville pour trouver de la nourriture. La police est à la recherche du voleur.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: La maison dirigeable
programme.desc: Tout est prêt pour la fête d'anniversaire de Jack, mais les cafards gonflent toutes les montgolfières à l'hélium et les lâchent dans le grenier. Elles se collent au plafond et soudain, la maison s'envole et flotte dans le ciel comme un énorme dirigeable.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Haute sécurité
programme.desc: Exasperated by the roaches' practical jokes, Oggy orders an airtight, hermetically sealed room where he can close himself up and then, with help from a remote control, activate the various traps he has set all over the house.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards
programme.sub-title: Oggy au centre de la terre
programme.desc: En poursuivant les cafards, Oggy tombe dans un puits et se retrouve propulsé dans le ventre de la terre avec Joey. Celui-ci est rempli de tunnels et de passages qui se ressemblent tous et très vite, nos deux amis sont totalement perdus !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Campagne pour tout le monde
programme.desc: Olivia décide de faire une surprise à Oggy et l'emmène dans une vieille ferme à la campagne. Ce n'est pas vraiment la destination rêvée d'Oggy.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: La course aux papillons
programme.desc: Oggy trouve un joli papillon jaune dans son jardin et celui-ci commence à se comporter comme un animal de compagnie. Oggy lui apprend rapidement à faire des tours comme un animal de cirque. Olivia tombe sous le charme du papillon. Bob est jaloux...

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Menu Vapeur
programme.desc: Oggy, Jack et Bob décident de construire un sauna dans la maison : quel meilleur moyen de perdre du poids ?

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Pas de poux pour Oggy
programme.desc: Un jour, Oggy se lève en se grattant la tête. Comme il ne sait pas pourquoi, il prête son peigne à Jack qui le prête à Bob. Et tous se mettent à se gratter et à se gratter comme des fous. Olivia comprend en un clin d'œil ce qui se passe : ils ont des poux

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Téléportation
programme.desc: Oggy vient d'acheter une machine de téléportation. Il peut désormais faire ses courses sans se fatiguer : il se téléporte au magasin, puis appuie sur le bouton de sa télécommande et se retrouve téléporté à la maison.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Oggy champion de sport
programme.desc: Très ennuyé de ne pas pouvoir regarder les Jeux Olympiques à la télévision à cause des cafards, Oggy et Jack finissent par les capturer et leur font jouer toutes les épreuves sportives.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Catch!
programme.desc: Jack convainc Oggy de s'inscrire à un concours de lutte organisé par Bob. Il s'avère qu'Oggy est plutôt doué pour la lutte ! Dee-Dee veut participer au concours, mais Jack l'envoie promener. C'était sans compter sur la détermination de Dee-Dee.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Bons baisers de Bombay
programme.desc: Jack invite Olivia et Oggy à la finale de cricket, son sport favori, et la finale se déroule... à Mumbai ! Fans de Bollywood, les cafards sont aussi de la partie...

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Oggy tombe dans le panneau
programme.desc: L'une des blagues des cafards se retourne contre eux et le chauffe-eau d'Oggy explose. Il doit le changer rapidement. Profitant de la situation, Oggy décide de se mettre au vert et installe un panneau solaire sur son toit.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Pas vu pas pris
programme.desc: Oggy se prépare une boisson végétale. Mais dès qu'il a le dos tourné, les cafards mettent des trucs bizarres dans le mixeur. Oggy boit le mélange d'un trait. Et la potion a un résultat immédiat, mais inattendu : Oggy devient... INVISIBLE !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Dee Dee détective
programme.desc: Oggy a été cambriolé ! Déprimé, Oggy réagit bizarrement. Il fait comme si de rien n'était. Il fait semblant de regarder la télé, d'ouvrir le frigo... DeeDee part enquêter !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: La guerre du bouton
programme.desc: Un matin, Olivia se réveille avec un bouton sur le front. Argh ! Elle s'enferme dans sa maison et refuse d'en sortir. En surfant sur Internet, Oggy trouve une recette anti-acné à base de... cafards !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Les Cafards à la Poubelle
programme.desc: Oggy et Jack ont trouvé un nouveau travail : ils deviennent éboueurs ! Et ils partent vider les poubelles du quartier tôt le matin. Par chance, les cafards se trouvaient dans la première poubelle que nos chats ont ramassée.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Contrôle technique
programme.desc: Jack a transformé le garage d'Oggy en garage de mécanique automobile. Bob est leur premier client. Sa voiture a besoin d'être réparée et c'est Oggy le singe gris qui est de service. Problème : il ne connaît rien à la mécanique automobile.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Les livreurs de l'extrême
programme.desc: Bob engage Oggy et Jack comme livreurs. Ils ont un camion flambant neuf rempli de cartons à livrer. Ils ne sont pas des pros, mais ils font de leur mieux jusqu'à ce que les cafards essaient de saboter leurs tournées.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Le vainqueur de l'étape
programme.desc: Tout le monde est très excité par le Tour de France qui va passer devant la maison d'Oggy.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Panique au pole nord
programme.desc: Veille de Noël au Pôle Nord, où la fabrique de jouets est plus active que jamais. Les pingouins travaillent sans relâche. Déguisés en pingouins, les cafards enlèvent le Père Noël !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Oggy se marie !
programme.desc: Oggy est à Venise avec Olivia, le cadre idéal pour une demande en mariage. Jack est là aussi... et les cafards, bien sûr.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Oggy Gardien de phare
programme.desc: Oggy et Jack doivent remplacer un de leurs amis bretons qui doit assister à un concours de cornemuse. Ils deviennent donc gardiens de phare pour la journée.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Volte Face
programme.desc: Grâce aux pouvoirs magiques de la lorgnette d'une sorcière, les rôles des habitants de la maison sont inversés : les cafards sont maintenant aussi grands qu'Oggy, tandis que les chats deviennent aussi petits que les cafards ! Oggy et Jack tentent de récup

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Le Sosie d'Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy est en train d'arroser les haies de son jardin lorsqu'il voit passer devant lui un chat qui lui ressemble comme deux gouttes d'eau. Émerveillé, il invite le chat à venir boire une tasse de thé. Les chats se regardent : ce sont des sosies ! Jack se pr

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Gardiens de Nuit
programme.desc: Oggy et Jack sont gardiens de nuit dans une centrale nucléaire. Les cafards ne veulent pas rater ça ! Ils entrent dans la salle de contrôle, et en deux temps trois mouvements, tous les voyants d'alerte passent au rouge ! Oggy les poursuit et se retrouve a

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: La Cigale et le Cafard
programme.desc: Par un après-midi ensoleillé, Oggy conduit son scooter en souriant, lorsqu'un insecte volant se fracasse sur ses dents. C'est une cigale. Comme elle est blessée, Oggy la ramasse et la ramène chez lui pour la soigner.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: L'Ancêtre
programme.desc: Oggy jardine tranquillement lorsqu'il tombe soudain dans un trou et se retrouve dans une grotte ! Perdu au milieu de plusieurs peintures rupestres, Oggy trouve un gros cafard préhistorique poilu coincé dans un bloc de glace.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Affreux, Sale et Gentil
programme.desc: Les cafards tentent de s'introduire dans le réfrigérateur mais Oggy coupe le câble que les insectes grimpaient pour atteindre leur objectif. Joey tombe et reste allongé sur le sol. Mais au moment où Oggy s'apprête à le punir, Joey lui sourit tendrement.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Vive les Mariés!!
programme.desc: Jack se marie et choisit Oggy comme témoin. Bien qu'ils n'aient pas été invités, les cafards sont bien sûr présents à la fête ! Jack offre un détecteur anti-cafards à Oggy pour l'aider à se débarrasser de ces satanés insectes.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Cafards Abandonnés
programme.desc: Jack et Oggy font un voyage en voiture, en direction de la plage. Sur la banquette arrière, les cafards sèment la pagaille dans la voiture. Les chats ne réagissent pas : ils ont un plan...

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: 3 Pièces Cuisine
programme.desc: Oggy en a assez de ces cafards diaboliques ! Cette fois, il déménage ! Il loue un appartement en ville tandis que les cafards restent seuls dans la maison vide qui leur semble soudain très grande. S'ennuyant, les cafards décident d'aller voir Oggy.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Formule 1
programme.desc: Jack annonce à Oggy qu'il va participer à une course de Formule 1 ! Une seconde plus tard, les deux chats se retrouvent au milieu du Grand Prix ! Les cafards, qui ont suivi les deux chats, ont discrètement mis un somnifère dans le verre de Jack.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Tribulations en Chine
programme.desc: Sur la grande muraille de Chine, un vendeur étalage achète les cafards à Oggy. En s'en allant, Oggy se sent rapidement coupable : ce sont ses amis après tout ! Il décide donc de les racheter, mais entre-temps, leur prix a été multiplié par 1000 !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Le Fugitif
programme.desc: Oggy prend Dee-Dee en flagrant délit de vol de nourriture dans son réfrigérateur. Pour échapper à l'emprise du chat, le cafard fait semblant d'être mort. Ses congénères et complices appellent immédiatement la police et Oggy est accusé de meurtre !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Invincible
programme.desc: En chassant les cafards sur le toit, Oggy s'écrase sur le sol. Sa tête est aussi plate qu'une crêpe, mais lorsqu'il se relève, il ne ressent aucune douleur et refuse l'aide de Jack ! Jack est convaincu qu'Oggy est devenu un super-héros invincible.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Oggy et le Sourire Magique
programme.desc: Oggy achète un sourire en carton dans un magasin de farces et attrapes. Lorsqu'il met le sourire en carton sur son visage, il se transforme immédiatement en un athlète musclé et super confiant !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Coup de jeune
programme.desc: Une sorcière vole dans le ciel sur son balai lorsque son chapeau s'envole et disparaît dans les nuages. Elle fait demi-tour et se lance à sa poursuite. Le chapeau atterrit dans la cour d'Oggy !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards: Oggy Petit Poucet
programme.desc: Oggy rentre chez lui avec son caddie plein de nourriture. Mais trouver sa maison devient une tâche impossible car toutes les rues se ressemblent ! Il décide alors de laisser une traînée de courses derrière lui, comme le petit Tom Pouce.

programme.desc: Os caminhoneiros entregam a torre de 40m no local de exploração, mas antes de ser erguida, eles também devem transportar a subestrutura de 80 toneladas que formará sua base. Pesando 72 mil quilos, o peso combinado as torna as cargas mais pesadas.

programme.title: Lowrider Brasil
programme.desc: Tatá orienta Joddy, um aspirante a membro do car club, no upgrade da tapeçaria de seu Impala. Mas quando o Vida Real é convidado para participar de um clipe com o rapper Afro-X dali a poucos dias, o projeto precisa ser acelerado de última hora.

programme.title: Lowrider Brasil
programme.desc: Switch é como se chama o comando que faz o carro pular. Aprender a mexer neste controle é um passo importante no lowrider, e é isso que Tatá tenta ensinar a Renê, que há anos vem construindo seu carro esperando por esse momento.

programme.title: Direção Sobre Rodas - Temporada 1
programme.desc: Pode acelerar, pois não vai ser fácil pegar esse fusca na pista. Fusca preparado com motor de subaru.

programme.title: Direção Sobre Rodas - Temporada 1
programme.desc: Paixão movida e acelerada pelos clássicos e exclusivos maverick

programme.title: Direção Sobre Rodas - Temporada 1

programme.title: Aero, Por Trás da Aviação
programme.sub-title: Voo de Trike e Head-up display
programme.desc: O trike é conhecido como a “moto da aviação”, uma aeronave simples que oferece uma grande sensação de liberdade durante o voo. E descubra como funciona o Head-up Display.

programme.title: Aero, Por Trás da Aviação
programme.sub-title: Voo em Oshkosh e como funciona o APU
programme.desc: O Aero te leva para voar com um avião turboélice no maior evento de aviação do mundo, em Oshkosh, nos Estados Unidos. O programa também mostra o que é e como funciona o APU.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: Esse Honra CRX 1987 teve seu corpo reaproveitado e ganhou uma pintura especial acentuada com gráficos em recorte em vinil personalizados nas cores preto e prata.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: Kerry acaba de se mudar a Cali e seu Escort 1989 é como Frankenstein: são dois carros soldados juntos! Não se sabe como as coisas se encaixam nem como elas funcionam, mas todos sabemos que esse carro é um perigo.

programme.title: Lowrider Brasil
programme.desc: Tatá, Japonês e Alemão viajam para Phoenix, cidade com uma das maiores cenas lowriders do mundo. Alemão conhece o car club Otra Vida, nascido a partir do seu bike club que tem o mesmo nome.

programme.title: Estradas Mortais: Homem Abatido
programme.desc: Bear e Eric devem transportar uma caldeira e um sinalizador para Langley ao mesmo tempo em que um urso polar é avistado. Rick está furioso com a longa viagem que seus chefes lhe atribuem. E a saúde de Alex continua piorando.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS stands for terror and the murder of millions. Documentary about the history of a symbol that represents murder.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Today’s infantry demands a weapon combining machine gun firepower with rifle accuracy and mobility.. Host Wil Willis traces this journey through iconic firearms.

programme.title: Secret War: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.sub-title: The Scholar and the Fight for Greece
programme.desc: Monty Woodhouse, a professor and a legend for blowing up the Gorgopotamos Bridge in Greece in 1942. In the British counter attack against Rommell at Al Alamein in North Africa it was vital to disrupt German supply routes, Greece.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.sub-title: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Weapons That Changed The World examines the RPG-7, renowned for its ability to take on tanks and level buildings. Host Wil Willis traces its evolution from WWII's Bazooka to modern counterparts like the AT-4 and Carl Gustav.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Inspirado por la Barra de Rata de un negocio, Danny envía a los muchachos a buscar piezas para un Barra de Rata para Count's Kustoms. En la búsqueda, Danny se distrae con la belleza de un Bel Air y se encuentra del otro lado de la mesa de negociaciones.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: La realeza de la industria musical Del Bryant tiene un Blazer y quiere homenajear a sus raíces de Tennessee mientras Mike y Ryan miran un Oldmobile muy raro de 1963 que creen que el Count debe tener.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Kevin y el equipo se reúnen para hacerle algo especial a Danny. Mientras tanto, Danny se encuentra con un viejo amigo y su Corvette a gas de 1959, pero es muy atractivo cuando lo posee el rey mismo que pone de rodillas a Danny.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Como en los dibujos animados, el Plymouth Road Runner siempre ha evitado a Danny. Cuando él por fin encuentra uno y lo compra, se convierte en una pesadilla para Kevin. Cuando Kevin intenta cancelar el proyecto, Danny propone uno rápido.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny debe cederle su preciado Monte Carlo de 1972 a uno de sus mayores clientes y cuenta con su equipo para terminar el trabajo en una semana. Mientras tanto, Ryan y Mike dan el paseo de sus vidas en un Fastback Mustang de 1965.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny está inspirado para retomar un viejo proyecto, un Ford Bronco de 1967 en el que ha invertido mucho tiempo y dinero, pero para ganar dinero, el negocio tendrá que modificarlo rápidamente. Mientras tanto, un cliente trae una Harley de 1950.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny tiene un cliente listo para comprar el Ford de 1967 que está restaurando, pero el error de Ryan ha retrasado el proyecto. Mike y Roli ajustan cuentas en un campo de tiro mientras Shannon mantiene la paz. Danny mira un camión de bomberos de 1980.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Cuando se le pide a Danny que haga una moto conmemorativa que honre a la leyenda musical, debe eliminar todos los obstáculos, y espera que su equipo termine en 30 días. Mike quiere impresionar a Danny y mira un Dodge de 1940 que está a la venta.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Negro, blanco y bólido en todas partes
programme.desc: Danny y los chicos se encuentran con un cliente que quiere un trabajo de pintura para que concuerde con su auto trucado Anglia. Mientras tanto, Shannon y Ryan hacen una Harley Davidson de turismo para un cliente que usa una moto de policía readaptada.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny tiene un cliente que quiere restaurar una camioneta Ford de 1942 que vio algo de acción en la Segunda Guerra Mundial, pero cuando Danny acepta el proyecto, se entera de que necesitará más amor de lo que creía.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El legendario rockero George Lynch de la banda metálica Dokken va de visita con su hermoso Buick Riviera de 1965.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El “Encantador de Motores” Doc tiene un hermoso Firebird de 1967 en el que ha estado trabajando. Aunque es un maestro de la mecánica debajo del capó, no es muy habilidoso con la pintura, así que llama a Ryan para hacer que se vea lo mejor posible.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Nunca olvidas tu primer Z28 Parte 1
programme.desc: Este episodio de dos partes comienza con un cliente que le pide a Danny que busque y construya un Camaro Z28 de 1979 para conmemorar su primer auto. Luego de encontrar uno en línea, se enteran de que el auto no está en las condiciones que creían.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Nunca olvidas tu primer Z28 Parte 2
programme.desc: La batalla de Danny con la pesadilla Z28 sigue cuando lo somete a una infinita elaboración para hacerlo recobrar vida. Mientras lo revive, Danny hace una pausa para visitar la colección de autos de Steve Barton y ver si lo puede convencer de vender.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: El sueño de Danny, la pesadilla de Kevin
programme.desc: Danny quiere un Plymouth Roadrunner desde que una pareja de locos por los autos lo detuvo hace unos años y le compró su Sebring en el momento.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Las motos de turismo no eligen
programme.desc: Un cliente quiere adornar su Harley Davidson Road Glide de 2004, pero ni Shannon ni Ryan saben si pueden hacer todo lo que quiere.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny encontró y compró un reemplazo para su amado buggy “Sparkles”. Mientras, los muchachos lo convierten en la mejor fantasía playera de los años 70.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Retan a Ryan a pintar una Harley Trike según el espíritu de “La noche estrellada” de Van Gogh, y Kevin encuentra un auto que podría ser uno de los más valiosos que haya visto… si es que es original.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny quiere que Ryan arregle una llama mal pintada en su amado auto de policía que lleva años en el negocio. Un cliente le pide a Shannon que restaure su Iron Head Sportster de 1979 que es más una pila de partes que una moto.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: El corazón está en el cromo
programme.desc: Danny intenta retomar el proyecto abandonado del Caddy 1962, mientras Ryan intenta reparar el daño de un percance. Cuando Danny finalmente revela su Caddy de 1962 terminado, ¿el plan de pintura de Ryan hará que haya valido la pena el esfuerzo?

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny planea darle el toque Count's Kustoms a una clásica Harley Davidson que espera vender por mucho dinero, pero cuando la moto llega a Horny Mike, todo el proyecto está en peligro. Mientras tanto, Danny encuentra un Mercury raro.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: El que lo encuentra se lo queda
programme.desc: Danny compra un Ford F100 de 1974 y no ve la hora de adornarlo y cambiarlo para ganar mucho dinero, pero cuando The Count se enamora de un camión y decide conservarlo, Kevin debe venderlo antes de que Danny se dé cuenta.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Mike les regala a los muchachos unas drifter trikes con una condición: deben personalizarlas y correr con ellas en la pista local. Todos menos Kevin están a la altura del desafío.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El exguitarrista de Guns & Roses DJ Ashba llega a Count's Kustoms en un Lamborghini Murciélago de 2004 que quiere convertir en el mejor “auto de hombre”, pero Danny debe asegurarse de que incluya algo especial para la esposa de DJ.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny comienza un proyecto que ha estado esperando mucho tiempo, un Chevy C10 Pick Up de 1971. Planea modificarlo para ganar mucho dinero, pero un caos en el departamento de pintura amenaza con llevar el presupuesto a las nubes.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny sigue su amor por El Caminos con una belleza de 1975, pero si va a modificar el auto para obtener mucho dinero, el equipo de Count’s Kustoms deberá dejar de lado sus diferencias.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny recibe un buggy para adornar con el estilo extravagante de Count's Kustoms, y luego se mete en un vehículo con muchos más caballos de fuerza en la Fundación Shelby Heritage. También Mike y Roli se dedican a un Karmann Ghia clásico.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny y el equipo aceptan un Caddy para un cliente de alta gama, pero ¿funcionará el plan de Ryan y Danny de hacer concordar el interior con una pintura color cerveza de raíz? El amigo de Danny Jeff Blando de la banda Slaughter pasa por el negocio.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny tiene grandes planes para un cliente nuevo, pero ¿el giro malvado que le hará a un Caddy clásico impresionará al comprador ricachón o lo dejará sin gasolina?

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Killer Police

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Overlord
programme.desc: After a careful campaign of disinformation that throws the German defenders off-guard, the Western Allies finally land on Normandy.France is liberated.

programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek

programme.sub-title: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: A Dog For Life

programme.title: A Dog For Life

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: “Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to connect with the spirit of murdered Christchurch scrap-metal dealer, John Reynolds, to discover his killer and reveal the truth surrounding the violent attack.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Seeking Siegfried
programme.desc: Katikati man Siegfried Newman disappeared on February 25, 2008, after he had dropped his sons Thomas, 9, and Oliver, 7, at Pahoia School. Police carried out a three-day search but found no sign of him.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Where's Grandad?
programme.desc: 65-year-old Alan Gordon Woodford of Bedford St. Mossburn left his home on foot Saturday morning April 20, 1985 and was never seen or heard of again.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: 19-year-old Joan Wech left New Zealand for the bright lights of Sydney. But the first step on her overseas adventure would be her last. Was this a robbery gone wrong, a savage random attack or a revenge killing by a jealous ex-lover?

programme.title: Sensing Murder: A Mother's Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Otautau toddler Amber-Lee, aged two and a half, vanished from Kingston at the southern tip of Lake Wakatipu on October 17, 1992.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Last Orders
programme.desc: In 1993, devoted father Kevin O'Loughlin came face to face with the dark side of sunny Nelson when he was brutally stabbed to death after a night out on the town.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Without Warning
programme.desc: This week’s episode of Sensing Murder promises greater co-operation between psychics and police, attempting to uncover the truth about the death of 18-year-old apprentice plumber Regan O’Donoghue, who was killed in a hit and run in 2007.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Vanishing Point
programme.desc: In 2003, 32-year-old mother of three Sara Neithe vanished from the Hauraki Plains. Neither Sara nor her car have been seen since. Police suspect that Sara has been murdered but without a crime scene, they have been unable to advance the case.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: The Lie of the Land
programme.desc: Sue Nicholson and Deb Webber investigate one of the most complex and intriguing cases ever featured - did Waikato man Jason Dark commit suicide or was he murdered, as his family believes?

programme.title: Sensing Murder: When The Trail Goes Cold
programme.desc: This episodes involves the disappearance of 62-year-old Kaye Stewart, a woman who went missing while on a short walk on June 13th, 2005.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Looking for Justice
programme.desc: This week, for the first time ever, the prime suspect in a murder enquiry has turned to Sensing Murder for help.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Lost for Words
programme.desc: Spirited teenager Jayne Furlong dreamed of becoming a child psychologist - instead, she ended up a prostitute. In 1993, 17 year old Jayne vanished from her patch on Auckland's Karangahape Road.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Psychics Revealed - Special
programme.desc: Behind the scenes with the psychics on the show.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: Described as a brutal execution, 46-year-old grandmother Chattrice Maihi-Carroll was found naked, stabbed to death in her New Zealand home in 2008. There were multiple suspects and everything seemed resolved following the arrest of a neighbour.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Le goût du risque
programme.desc: Todd, un vieil ami de Callaway, se tue lors d'un saut en parachute. Le policier décide d'enquêter pour son compte, en s'immisçant dans un groupe de sportifs de l'extrême, qu'il soupçonne être à l'origine de cet accident…

programme.title: Pacific Blue: L’escalade
programme.desc: Un nouveau bar vient d'ouvrir sur la plage. Son propriétaire, un raciste patenté, entreprend de débarrasser la côte des vendeurs hispaniques et des surfeurs étrangers. Cory essaie, quant à elle, de remettre un jeune tagueur sur le droit chemin…

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Coup de froid
programme.desc: Cory est accusée par une commission d'enquête d'avoir utilisé abusivement son arme, au cours d'un accrochage avec un malfrat…

programme.title: Pacific Blue: La tempête
programme.desc: Une bande de voyous commet des vols armés d'une violence inouïe. Se lançant à leur poursuite, Callaway se retrouve dans une situation critique. Il réalise qu'il peut mourir à tout instant. Une idée obsédante dont il ne parvient pas à se débarrasser…

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Santé menacée
programme.desc: La patrouille découvre un vaste trafic de stéroïdes dans le milieu du culturisme. Parmi les sportifs concernés par cette affaire figure Annette, une jeune femme qui travaille comme serveuse chez Sheila...

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Retour vers le passé
programme.desc: Il y a quelques années, le lieutenant Palermo avait dû affronter un redoutable tueur en série. Plusieurs meurtres l'amènent à penser que cet assassin a repris du service…

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Le Phoenix
programme.desc: Le Phoenix, un pyromane présumé mort, est de retour à Venice. Chris et Callaway font équipe pour le retrouver. Quant à Cory, elle est à la recherche d’un marchand sans licence, et se retrouve sur la scène d'un concours de t-shirts mouillés…

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Cible mouvante
programme.desc: Alors qu'il poursuit un voleur, Callaway rencontre par hasard la femme qu'il a failli épouser quand il avait 20 ans...

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Une dure journée
programme.desc: Cory et Callaway se trouvent dans une banque au moment où trois malfaiteurs entrent pour commettre un hold-up. Très vite, le vol à main armée se transforme en prise d'otages...

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Prise de risques
programme.desc: Elvis a mis au point un logiciel qui, d'après ses calculs, peut rapporter beaucoup d'argent. Scott, une nouvelle recrue, arrive à la caserne...

programme.title: Pacific Blue: En roue libre
programme.desc: Cory a un nouveau petit ami, qui désire lui présenter ses parents. Mais la jeune femme fait passer sa mission avant tout. Elle doit jouer les filles de mauvaise vie, afin de piéger un dangereux trafiquant d'armes...

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Ombre et lumiere
programme.desc: Muni d'engins explosifs élaborés, un poseur de bombes fait courir la police aux quatre coins de la ville. Il finit par exiger que le réseau électrique de Santa Monica soit coupé pendant toute une nuit.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: La traque
programme.desc: Sandy, la petite amie de Callaway, est victime d'un violeur en série qui sévit depuis peu. La police craint que l'homme ne quitte la région. Cory propose d'attirer le violeur dans un piège.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Permis d’expulser demandé
programme.desc: La patrouille se retrouve confrontée à des voyous qui harcèlent les locataires d'un vieil immeuble. Le nouveau propriétaire du bâtiment a prévu de le raser.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: La guerre des clans
programme.desc: Victor s'est pris d'affection pour Ricky, un adolescent qu'il tente de sauver de la délinquance. Lorsque le garçon lui présente Linda, sa grande soeur, Victor tombe immédiatement sous le charme. Mais Ricky se sent trahi et s'enfuit.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Jeu de piste
programme.desc: Callaway se fait dérober son arme au cours d'une intervention musclée. Le criminel est retrouvé mort, tué avec l'arme volée. Pendant ce temps, Victor se lance à la poursuite de kidnappeurs de chiens.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: L’ennemi est dans la place
programme.desc: Trois malfaiteurs masqués et armés térrorisent la communauté asiatique. Ils ont réussi à se procurer les clés des maisons et entrent chez les gens sans effraction. Pour les retrouver, la brigade fait appel à un médium, ce qui laisse Chris très sceptique.

programme.title: Pacific Blue: Harcèlement
programme.desc: Une partie de l'équipe traque des surfeurs qui ont agressé un kayakiste, dont le seul tort était de s'être installé sur leur plage. Afin d'empêcher leur victime de témoigner contre eux, les agresseurs tentent d'intimider sa petite amie.

programme.title: South Park: Quintuplets 2000

programme.title: South Park: Cherokee Hair Tampons

programme.title: South Park: Chef Goes Nanners

programme.title: South Park: Something You Can Do With Your Finger

programme.title: South Park: Do the Handicapped Go to Hell? (Part 1)
programme.sub-title: Do the Handicapped Go to Hell? (Part 1)

programme.title: South Park: Probably (Part 2)
programme.desc: Probably (2): The boys build a church-shaped shack to live in and listen to Cartman the preacher man. Meanwhile, Satan turns to an unlikely source for advice about his relationship woes. (S4, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Fourth Grade

programme.title: South Park: Trapper Keeper

programme.title: South Park: Helen Keller! The Musical
programme.desc: Helen Keller! The Musical: The boys stage a Thanksgiving play about the life of author Helen Keller, starring Timmy as Helen. There's trouble involving his favourite turkey, Gobbles. (S4, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Pip!
programme.desc: Pip (a.k.a. Great Expectations): South Park's unusual version of the classic Dickens tale, featuring robot monkeys and the Genesis Device! Narrated in vision by Malcolm McDowell. (S4, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Fat Camp
programme.desc: Fat Camp: Cartman is sent to fat camp in order to resolve his weight problem but all is not as it seems when he returns skinny. Kenny gets his own TV show where he performs disgusting acts. (S4, E15)

programme.title: South Park: The Wacky Molestation Adventure
programme.desc: The Wacky Molestation Adventure: Kyle has his parents arrested so he can go to a concert but things get out of hand and it's not long before there are no adults left in town! (S4, E16)

programme.title: South Park: A Very Crappy Christmas

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman Must Die

programme.title: South Park: It Hits the Fan
programme.desc: It Hits The Fan: Swearing on a TV show leads to mass profanity in South Park. What does this have to do with The Black Death?! The you-know-what-hits the fan 162 times in this ep! (S5, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Cr***le Fight

programme.title: South Park: Terrance and Phillip: Behind the Blow

programme.title: South Park: Cartmanland

programme.desc: Grazie al suo avvocato, Sam viene a sapere che sua madre è in stato d'arresto a Las Vegas. Nonostante il rapporto non buono che ha con lei, Sam vorrebbe andare in Nevada per tirarla fuori.

programme.desc: Sam non riesce più a trovare il suo laptop. Dopo aver messo a ferro e fuoco la casa di Carly, quella di Freddie e il Groovy Smoothy, conclude che deve esserle stato rubato. Chi sarà stato?

programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie vorrebbero che il loro show fosse recensito. Carly rischia di ricevere una cattiva pubblicità quando insulta il supponente ragazzino undicenne che gestisce un popolare sito che dà i voti ai siti web.

programme.title: iCarly: Voglio stare con Spencer
programme.desc: Il nonno di Carly arriva per una visita ma è colpito dall'insolito comportamento di Spencer, cosicchè contesta la capacità di Spencer di sentirsi responsabile. Carly deve convincerlo che Spencer è in grado di fare il custode.

programme.desc: Il tema per il prossimo webcast di iCarly è capire che cosa significa fare gli insegnanti al di fuori della scuola. Quando Carly e Freddie seguono la signora Briggs, essi rimangono bloccati dentro la sua casa.

programme.title: iCarly: Un record da battere
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie vogliono battere il precedente record del mondo della più lunga trasmissione web in diretta, che è di poco più di 24 ore. L'impresa si rivela tutt'altro che facile.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La griglia di Gary
programme.desc: Drake e Josh vengono ingaggiati da due individui per vendere griglie dotate di lettore mp3 incorporato. I due ragazzi si rivelano abili venditori ma vengono interrotti dalla polizia che li arresta.

programme.desc: Drake dice al fratello che vorrebbe avere più tempo da trascorre da solo e Josh lo accontenta trovandosi un nuovo amico: Drew. Che, guarda a caso, è praticamente una copia di Drake.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La locanda di Drake & Josh
programme.desc: Drake vorrebbe lasciare Kelly, la ragazza con cui sta uscendo, ma scopre che è la figlia della sua professoressa d’inglese che è pronta a vendicarsi con il ragazzo se lui farà soffrire la sua bambina.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il peperone peruviano
programme.desc: Josh e Drake partecipano al concorso per la salsa più buona. Megan però viene esclusa dalla squadra e decide di vendicarsi partecipando alla gara e sabotando la loro ricetta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Marito e moglie
programme.desc: L’amica di penna di Josh, Yooka, arriva in america per conoscerlo. E’ una bella ragazza e Drake cerca subito di attirare la sua attenzione e addirittura si ritrova sposato con lei.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Mindy è tornata
programme.desc: Josh si prepara per l’esposizione di scienze. questa volta Mindy non partecipa alla gara, quindi il ragazzo è sicuro di vincere. Sul più bello però Mindy decide di presentarsi.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Relazione Clandestina
programme.desc: Drake sente il padre che parla sottovoce al telefono con una donna e si convince che sia la sua amante. Josh all’inizio non gli crede ma poi insieme al fratello decide di ostacolare questa relazione.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Tastare il terreno
programme.desc: Drake esce con Tori ma decide di lasciarla proprio quando sente la ragazza che lo definisce il suo fidanzato. Josh invece si fa crescere i baffi pensando che così gli altri lo rispettino di più.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: L'intervento di Helen
programme.desc: Josh viene promosso assistente manager del cinema. Il ragazzo cerca di fare il possibile per dimostrare di essere all’altezza dell’incarico ma naturalmente Drake gli mette i bastoni tra le ruote.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il dottor Drake
programme.desc: Josh viene colpito da una patata sparata da Drake. Cerca di nascondere il suo infortunio ma alla fine deve essere ricoverato. Drake invece, si finge medico e si caccia nei guai.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La mano di gomma
programme.desc: Josh racconta di quando a otto anni, allo stadio un bambino l’ha picchiato e gli ha rubato la sua mano in gommapiuma. Quel bambino era Drake e i due cominciano a litigare sulla versione della storia.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Girl power
programme.desc: Mindy invita Josh a cena per fargli conoscere i suoi genitori, ma le cose non vanno bene. Josh organizza un’altra cena a casa sua per cercare di impressionare i genitori di Mindy e rimediare.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il mistero della pecora
programme.desc: Josh e Drake sentono dei rumori che provengono dal garage. Vanno a controllare e trovano una pecora. Arriva Megan che racconta di averla comprata in rete e chiede ai ragazzi di tenerla nascosta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il nuovo insegnante di Megan
programme.desc: Josh viene ammesso in un’associazione che permette agli studenti delle superiori di insegnare ai bambini più piccoli. Il ragazzo capita nella classe di Megan e viene subito preso in antipatia...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Un Fratellino

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il rapinatore di Cinema

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il "demonator"

programme.desc: Drake e Josh decidono di ripagare Megan con la stessa moneta e di vendicarsi per i tanti scherzi subiti. La inducono così a pensare che gli alieni esistono davvero...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Lo show della dottoressa Phyllis
programme.desc: Drake e Josh ultimamente non fanno altro che litigare e Megan non riesce più a dormire di notte per il chiasso che fanno...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Hollywood parte 1
programme.desc: Walter e Audrey partono per una crociera di dieci giorni. Drake e Josh non vedono l’ora di avere la casa a loro disposizione dal momento che anche Megan andrà a Denver a trovare un’amichetta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Hollywood parte 2

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Hollywood parte 3

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Sorprese di compleanno

programme.desc: Josh si offre volontario per dar da mangiare al cane e innaffiare le piante della signora Hayfer mentre è fuori città. Drake, che è il peggior alunno della signora Hayfer, vuole unirsi al fratello.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La gara di scienze
programme.desc: Mindy confessa a Josh di amarlo e, vista la reazione poco convinta mostrata dal fidanzatino, gli consiglia di riflettere durante il fine settimana prima di comunicarle i suoi sentimenti.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La prozia si sposa
programme.desc: La famiglia di Drake e Josh è invitata al matrimonio della prozia Catherine, un'antipatica e ricchissima novantenne. La famiglia la sopporta perchè spera nell'eredità.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La scommessa
programme.desc: Drake e Josh fanno una scommessa a chi riuscirà a ottenere più appuntamenti con le ragazze in una settimana. Audrey decide di aiutare Josh e il trucco sembra funzionare a meraviglia.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il grande Doheny
programme.desc: Josh incontra al Premiere il famoso mago Henry Doheny, di cui è un grande ammiratore. L’uomo è in città per qualche giorno e il ragazzo si offre di aiutarlo qualora avesse bisogno.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Regalo di anniversario
programme.desc: Drake e Josh partecipano a un concorso che mette in palio la ristrutturazione di una stanza della casa. I due fratelli vogliono fare una sorpresa ai genitori e regalare loro un soggiorno tutto nuovo.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il temporale
programme.desc: Drake e la sua band devono aprire il concerto dei The Sparks e il ragazzo è nervoso. Josh ha pensato di invitare a casa amici e conoscenti e festeggiare il risultato ottenuto dal fratello.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La macchina nuova
programme.desc: Josh e Drake vogliono comprare un’automobile ma non riescono a trovare un accordo. Di nascosto dal fratello, Drake usa invece i soldi di entrambi per comprare un orangotango, Bobo.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La casa sull'albero
programme.desc: Drake e Josh costruiscono un razzo che vola fuori dalla finestra e incendia la casa sull'albero dei vicini. I ragazzi vengono così costretti a trascorrere l'intero sabato a ricostruire la casetta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Con te ho chiuso
programme.desc: Per colpa di Drake, Josh arriva in ritardo a un importantissimo compito di chimica. Per Josh è la goccia che fa traboccare il vaso, e il ragazzo decide che con il fratellastro ha chiuso.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Patricia le cuenta a Antonio que esperan un hijo, pero él lo rechaza. Reinaldo apoya a su hija al enterarse del embarazo. José Salinas se le mete en la cama a Griselda y ella lo saca a patadas. Griselda le propone a Iris que administre su mansión.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Reinaldo se enfrenta a Antonio, lo golpea y lo echa de la casa. Teresa Cristina se entera por Elsa del embarazo de Patricia. Enfurecido, Reinaldo le asegura a Teresa Cristina que si echa a Patricia de la casa, él se irá con su hija y la abandonará.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Teresa Cristina y Griselda se enfrentan por el bebé de Patricia y Antonio, yéndose casi a las manos, pero interviene a tiempo Reinaldo y se lleva a su esposa. José, aprovechando que está sólo en casa, comienza a buscar el tesoro por el que volvió.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Irene advierte a Lucho del micrófono oculto. Aníbal lee el testamento que Valentina firmó y le advierte a Antonia que ese documento la convierte en sospechosa. Poncia le cuenta a Alejandro que Antonia está alcoholizando a David. Gastón corre peligro.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Rodrigo empieza a sospechar de la maldad de Antonia. Verónica y sus aliados están listos para atacar, ella le dice a Alejandro que teme su odio cuando acabe con Antonia Guerra. Francisca tiene un sueño revelador donde ve todo el accidente de su hijo.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Antonia discute con Verónica por David y su alcoholismo. Dantés sufre al ver a su hijo tan desprotegido. Irene empieza a arrepentirse de sus viejos actos y quiere ayudar a Lucho en su plan. Rodrigo tiene nuevas pistas del accidente de Valentina y Max.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Constanza le cuenta a Rodrigo todo el calvario vivido en el manicomio; también le habla de su relación con Gabriela y Lucho. David se muda a casa de Francisca y Antonia enfurece. Los guardaespaldas de Verónica salvan a Gastón de un atentado.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma acompaña a Gabriela para rescatar a Jimena, su madre se ofende al saber que ella trabaja en la panadería de Juan. Rosario renuncia al bar para irse de gira con otro representante.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Gabriela ve a Norma y a Juan cuando se besan, ella le revela quién es el padre de su hijo, su madre cae desmayada, mientras Fernando escucha tras la puerta y sale armado de la hacienda.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Fernando encuentra a su esposa con las maletas listas, él le deja el camino libre, Gabriela prefiere que se vaya su hija y no Fernando. Juan se angustia porque no conoce la decisión de Norma.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Jimena invita a Norma a cenar en la casa de Juan, él tiene miedo de perderla. Franco recibe una oferta de trabajo de Eduvina Trueba, una viuda millonaria que hace lo imposible para seducirlo.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Blinded in an explosion, Lucas fights despair as he prepares for a meeting with a gun-toting enemy.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A deranged ex-prisoner of war, cruelly abused in a Northern army prison, captures Lucas, locks him in a cage and vows to make him suffer for his part in the Civil War.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A traveling salesman can't talk his way out of an assault charge.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.sub-title: Short Rope for a Tall Man

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A janitor-turned-gunfighter's reputation hangs on one lucky shot and a lot of gall. The handyman finds himself in trouble when he accidentally kills another gunfighter.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas tries to get help when he is shot after witnessing a murder.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: After being foreman of a jury that convicted an Apache, Lucas is marked for death. Now, he must discover who is behind the curse.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas allows some snowed-in stagecoach passengers to stay with him until the roads are passable. Trouble brews when the whiskey salesman and gunfighter fall for the same woman.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Two pranksters write away for a mail-order bride, using Lucas's name.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas recognizes Dr. Battle as an ex-gunslinger with whom he once fought. He helps with a dying man, but Lucas and the doctor have unresolved anger.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A Chinese man and his son fight prejudice as they try to open a laundry in North Fork.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: While Lucas and Mark are traveling across the Mexican desert they encounter a trio of Mexican bandits who demand payment to cross "their" desert.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark takes a job as a stable boy against his father's wishes.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark and Milly are held hostage in her general store when two gunmen attempt a daring robbery.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas turns them down because they are escorting a murderer, to be hanged in Yuma.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark goes to work for Will Temple, a badly scarred, very mysterious rancher.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Corey Hazlett insists he's innocent of murder, despite Lucas's eyewitness testimony.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas tries to dissuade a latter-day knight from rushing into battle.

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Stubborn Grandpa Fogarty is Lucas's main roadblock as he tries to get young Woody Fogarty to attend school.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark Twain visits North Fork and quickly alienates the townspeople.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas tries to stop embittered John Holliver from venting his wrath on the people who expelled him from town years before.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas becomes the target of a vengeful mountaineer after he is responsible for a young mountain boy's death.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Mark is kidnapped and held for ransom, he finds himself an unwilling companion of gunman Carl Avery.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas seeks an escape when he's captured by outlaws while seeking help for an injured Mark.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The young Queen-to-be of France hides out in North Fork with her sick brother.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A notorious killer is being held in the North Fork jail. When word gets around that Gordo's gang is on its way to free him, the whole town becomes frightened.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas's old Army pal settles in North Fork with his deaf daughter.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An Englishman arrives with a custom-made rifle and a plan to kill Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los aliados de Alexandria atacan a la vez diferentes guaridas de los Salvadores, pero estos los superan en número y armamento y la batalla va a ser intensa, cruel y no exenta de bajas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Con Rick contra las cuerdas, la guerra contra los Saviors se recrudece e Hilltop, el Reino y Alejandría conocen el verdadero potencial del ejército de Negan.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Los Saviors poseen un arma de gran potencia que pretenden transportar para ayudar a Negan. Ezekiel, que ha sobrevivido a la matanza de sus hombres, y Carol, aislada en territorio enemigo, son los únicos que pueden impedir la entrega del arma.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Gabriel y Negan tienen que cooperar para salir con vida de la casa en la que están encerrados, con decenas de muertos vivientes tratando de comérselos. Mientras, los lugartenientes de Negan se dan cuenta de que uno de ellos es un traidor, ¿quién?

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: El rey, la viuda y Rick
programme.desc: Rick visita a Jadis para convencerla de que se una a ellos en la lucha contra Negan. En Hilltop, Gregory sugiere a Maggie, que está enojada con Jesús porque está alimentando a los prisioneros, que los ahorque. Carl se encuentra con Siddiq.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Tara rompen el muro del Santuario y los zombis entran al recinto. Negan exige a Eugene que idee una manera de sacarlos con vida de allí. Jadis prepara a Rick una muerte horrenda.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan y sus hombres atacan a las tres comunidades rebeldes al mismo tiempo. Sin Rick, Carl asume la defensa de Alexandria, cercada por el propio Negan. Mientras, Simon detiene al ejército de Hilltop en la carretera y Gavin quiere capturar a Ezekiel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carl hace una última petición a Rick y Michonne antes de morir. Mientras tanto, Morgan y Carol intentan rescatar a Ezekiel antes de que Gavin se lo entregue vivo a Negan para que este lo torture y asesine delante de sus seguidores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Negan ordena a Simon que mate solo a uno de los hombres de Jadis como escarmiento, pero Simon tiene sed de venganza. Mientras, Rick se dirige al basurero del grupo de Jadis para renovar su alianza, y Aaron sigue intentando obtener un acuerdo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: A Maggie se le acaban las reservas de alimentos y debe decidir si deja que los presos pasen hambre. Mientras, Daryl guía a los supervivientes de Alejandría a través de un pantano repleto de zombis, y la adversidad pone a prueba la fe de Gabriel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick ataca a Negan cuando este se dirigía a Hilltop y terminan enfrentándose en un edificio abandonado, pero Simon y Dwight siguen el rastro de Negan. Mientras tanto, Maggie, Enid, Michonne y Rosita discuten sobre la propuesta de una desconocida.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: No nos lleven por el mal camino
programme.desc: Los Saviors, ahora dirigidos por Simon, atacan Hilltop pese a que algunos de sus combatientes están dentro, presos. Maggie organiza la defensa del poblado, pero ¿podrán evitar una masacre como la que Simon perpetró contra el grupo de Jadis?

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Jadis planea una muerte horrenda para Negan. Mientras, Morgan va en busca de Henry y Rick sale de Hilltop para cazar a los que huyeron durante el asalto comandado por Simon. Finalmente, los dos se encuentran en territorio enemigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras los hombres de Negan continúan con su ofensiva, Aaron sigue buscando aliados nuevos, pese a que pueda costarle la vida. Daryl y Rosita se enfrentan a un viejo amigo.

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.desc: Manabu se revolta quando aprende na escola que vários animais já foram extintos por causa dos humanos. Logo depois Juunin Makunba, um ninja criminoso e caçador de animais em extinção, atenta contra a vida de Tetsuzan.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 8 - O Anjo da Paz Gōnin Abdad (Abudada, no original) Tōha(Jiraiya), Kei(Himenin Emiha) e Maira
programme.desc: A embaixatriz da república de Amel, Maira, é alvo de uma tentativa de assassinato por seu próprio tio, o ninja Abdad. Jiraiya e Emiha se juntam para defendê-la.

programme.title: Jiraya - O incrível Ninja
programme.sub-title: 9 - A Emboscada Família de Feiticeiros Tōha(Jiraiya), Tetsuzan, Rei Yagyū(Kinin Reiha), Ryū Asuka(Yanin Spiker) e Jōnin Barão Owl
programme.desc: Rei Yagyu é sequestrada pela Família dos Feiticeiro e o resgate exigido é a inscrição que revela Pako. Ryu pede ajuda a Toha e os dois traçam um plano para resgatá-la.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.sub-title: Os Representantes de Sua Majestade, O Imperador
programme.desc: Inúmeras borboletas atacam as pessoas. Elas são basicamente soldados de Crisis enviados do Mundo Kaima pelo Monstro Kaima Gimeragomera, responsável por criá-los.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: E mais um plano de Crisis para conquistar a humanidade é posto em ação: privar os humanos de ter acesso à água.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Em meio ao sofrimento do povo que está privado do acesso à água, a estratégia de Maribaron e os demais chega à fase final: ter o monopólio da água.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.sub-title: A Mulher Que Esteve em Kaima
programme.desc: Uma motoqueira com jaqueta vermelha passa por Issamu durante uma perseguição com Gatezon. A motoqueira em questão é Yuko Midorikawa.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.sub-title: O Céu do Amor e da Esperança
programme.desc: Maribaron obteve a chave para o Mundo Kaima. Issamu procura desesperadamente por Yuko, que tinha uma das peças que formava tal chave.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: O General Jark anuncia uma nova operação: a criação da Crisislândia, a primeira base terrestre de Crisis. O alvo é a Grande Ponte Setoo, na ilha de Shikoku.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: E mais uma vez o Império Crisis coloca a pequena ilha de Shikoku como alvo principal. Crianças com poderes psíquicos estão sendo raptadas uma após a outra por um misterioso homem velho. O que Crisis planeja com essas crianças? Qual o destino de Shikoku?

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Crisis iniciou uma operação que consiste na invasão de sistemas, e agora o sistema da polícia está em suas mãos. Pessoas inocentes estão sendo presas uma após a outra e Issamu também é uma delas.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: Surge um misterioso mascarado em cena, seu nome é Grande Máscara. Ele começa a derrotar campeões de diversas modalidades, um após o outro, tornando-se facilmente o novo ídolo das crianças.

programme.title: Kamen Rider Black RX
programme.desc: No pacífico Vilarejo Fujimura, uma espécie de OVNI aparece e começa a atacar os moradores.

programme.title: O Fantástico Jaspion
programme.desc: Crianas de uma vila local encontram um filhote de monstro. MacGaren e sua quadrilha, disfarçados, levam o monstrinho. Jaspion ajuda as crianças a recuperarem o filhote, mas MacGaren contra ataca.

programme.title: O Fantástico Jaspion
programme.desc: Quatro cientistas estão no caminho da cidade tecnológica de Tsukuba em uma lancha pelo rio. Quando voltam estão com os cabelos brancos, além disso começam a agir violentamente.
